thread:
Priya Content: Heads-up: preparing 3 launch posts + webinar next month. Need a short SEO ops checklist: canonical strategy, redirect mapping for legacy webinar/event pages, JSON-LD for the webinar landing, internal linking anchors from docs/blog, UTM conventions for promotional links, and one-paragraph benchmark narratives we can paste into PRs. Who wants what?
Sam SEO: I can scope KW clusters and the JSON-LD. High-level clusters: cost-efficiency, inference latency, deployment models. Long-tail seeds: "inference cost per token", "LLM serving latency at scale", "private model deployment options".
Sam SEO: Minimal Event JSON-LD to put in head (staging):```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Webinar: Cost-efficient LLM inference","startDate":"2025-06-10T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/resources/webinars/llm-inference-costs"},"performer":{"@type":"Person","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Sam SEO: Also add a small FAQ JSON-LD block for 3 Qs (cost, security, deployment). I'll drop 3 Q/A strings to the thread.
Matt (Growth): I'll own redirects + sitemap + GSC pings. Preference: consolidate under /resources/webinars/ and 301 old /webinars/ and /events/ paths. Quick example mapping CSV I can use:```
old_path,new_path,action
/webinars/2023/llm-costs,/resources/webinars/llm-inference-costs,301
/events/llm-costs-2024,/resources/webinars/llm-inference-costs,301
```
Matt (Growth): Q: keep UTM params in redirects or strip? For analytics it's useful to preserve utm_campaign but prefer canonical without query. We can preserve for campaign URLs and set canonical to the base URL.
Laura Ops: I'll run linking sweep after Matt shares final new_path list. Plan: ~12 contextual links from product docs, 4 links from blog launch posts, 2 links from case studies. Anchor suggestions: natural phrasing like "reducing inference costs", "Redwood inference deployment guide", "LLM latency patterns".
Jonah PM: For the launch posts + benchmark narrative: I want 3 ~2-3 sentence blurbs we can use in social, PR, and the webinar meta description. One focused on cost benchmarks (tokens/sec and $/1M tokens), one on latency guarantees, one on deployment flexibility. I can A/B headline treatments on the landing: headline A = "Cut inference spend by 3x" vs B = "Predictable latency for LLMs at scale".
Sam SEO: Headline choice should map to the prioritized KW for that landing. If main target = "inference cost" use the cost headline and include latency term in subhead. Also ensure Hreflang not needed for this launch (en-only).
Aliza G.: Action items: Sam 	6 lead on KW CSV + JSON-LD + 3 FAQ Qs (EOD). Matt 	6 redirect CSV + sitemap update + advise on UTM handling (tomorrow). Laura 	6 linking sweep once Matt shares final paths. Jonah 	6 benchmark blurbs + headline A/B setup. Priya 	6 draft launch post outlines + UTM naming scheme (utm_campaign=webinar-launch-june2025).
